notes.title: Project progress
notes.content:
We are creating and improving the bosses and final enemies so that there is more variety in the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/4183dc7439415feb2ada001a36dfd56c8212d76a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/adf85914186798db0aed2be18ea53d8fcf3b548d.png[/img]

On top of that we are updating the gameplay, to increase the feeling of reward for spending time defending the ship

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/f1cd602b0442d3ffc970a283dc704f71c6d7e08f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/3e9e25812d3b523610976f9ee40d97fa92338525.png[/img]

notes.title: Graphics Update and Mechanics Improves
notes.content:
We have worked on graphical improvements and some mechanical improvements to give the game more variety. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/26b3eadb2c54cf775853e92749adc7f922614e47.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/078521d9499eb64414ad4cc4fcf7f870228da306.png[/img]

We hope to launch the game by the end of August, it is not a really long game, the game was thought more like a roguelike where you collect coins to improve the ship, weapons and other elements to survive the enemies of the sea. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/03e8784b1b046b95180e2cc46932671c9854bce5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/e41dbec6f02624a6cdfd33982941d7a1b765d2e1.png[/img]

Lately we have added the chests that are used to collect various scrolls that will give you clues to face the three bosses in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/c27784af877cd27d526cafa3e36865ba40d561e6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40479809/9243065897c510193c012db1bd19c42973fc9b20.png[/img]

Soon we will show new enemies before the launch day. Thanks you for reading and interest in our game!.
